tool_calls.literal: /bin/bash -lc "jq -r '[.stack_frames[0], (if .value>0 then \"bad\" else \"good\" end), (.value|abs), .labels.source_session[0]] | @tsv' samples.jsonl | awk -F '\\t' '{k="'$1 FS $2; n[k]+=$3; s[k FS $4]=1} END {for(k in n){q=0; for(x in s) if(index(x,k FS)==1) q++; print k, n[k], q}}'"' | sort -k1,1 -k2,2"

/bin/bash -lc "jq -s '{bad_total:([.[]|select(.value>0)|.value]|add),good_total:([.[]|select(.value<0)|-.value]|add),bad_repeated:([.[]|select(.value>0 and .stack_frames[0]==\"result:repeated\")|.value]|add),good_repeated:([.[]|select(.value<0 and .stack_frames[0]==\"result:repeated\")|-.value]|add),bad_sessions:([.[]|select(.value>0 and .stack_frames[0]==\"result:repeated\")|.labels.source_session[0]]|unique|length),good_sessions:([.[]|select(.value<0 and .stack_frames[0]==\"result:repeated\")|.labels.source_session[0]]|unique|length)}' samples.jsonl
jq -s '[.[]|select(.stack_frames[0]==\"result:repeated\")|.value]|add' samples.jsonl"
